maes_1.why: Simultaneous equations require strong algebraic skills and logical thinking.

maes_2.why: Decimals involve basic arithmetic operations but can be tricky with larger numbers.

maes_3.why: Finding missing angles in triangles relies on understanding angle relationships.

maes_4.why: Algebra problems test problem-solving abilities and manipulation of equations.

maes_5.why: Trigonometry involves complex functions and requires a good grasp of ratios.

maes_6.why: Calculating area and volume needs knowledge of geometric formulas.

maes_7.why: Sketching curves demands understanding of function behavior and graphing skills.

maes_8.why: Working with fractions involves operations that can be less intuitive than whole numbers.

maes_9.why: Determining missing side lengths often requires applying the Pythagorean theorem.
